cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Empty seats at your opening? When I taught you to project, I warned you about that. Mine had two people, and both left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Have my complimentary drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to look after a performer. My theatre couldn't even afford that much sympathy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you listen now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine asked for a refund. You're only beginning to learn how that feels. Stay while I finish this drink; I haven't told anyone that.

reason: Remove arbitrary inability to talk standing; A greater hurt itself now motivates the request that B stay and listen.
